newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian business urged to use new trade area.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian business urged to use new trade area.

text.p: Indonesian businessmen have been urged to take advantage of trade and economic opportunities in provinces covered by the Australia-Indonesia Development Area (AIDA), the official Antara news agency reported on Friday.

Coordinating Minister for Production and Distribution Hartarto said the agreement, signed on Thursday with Australian Foreign Minister Alexander Downer in the town of Ambon, would give local businesses new opportunities and speed economic growth in eastern Indonesia.
He said large-, medium- or small-scale businesses would be able to easily strike up partnerships to expand their ventures in the trade region which covers all the islands east of Bali.
Downer took part in a dawn ANZAC Day ceremony at the Commonwealth war cemetery in the hills outside Ambon on Friday as part of the annual commemoration of Australia's World War II dead.
He then flew to Lombok island before a scheduled return to Australia on Saturday.
